name: jailsh
subtitle: A Unix shell that runs untrusted binaries — no Docker required.
description: A C++17 shell with an AST-based execution engine and a built-in kernel-enforced sandbox. Prefix any command with jail to isolate it using Linux namespaces, seccomp-BPF, and cgroups v2 — the same primitives containers use, implemented from scratch.
features: jail sandbox: namespaces + seccomp-BPF + cgroups v2 + capability stripping
Double-fork midwife pattern for correct PID namespace isolation
IPC handshake to resolve CLONE_NEWUSER UID mapping deadlock
Solved fork/SIGCHLD race conditions that caused ghost background jobs

name: Black Swan
subtitle: Most backtests tell you why a strategy works. Black Swan tries to prove it doesn't.
description: A headless A2A agent for adversarial robustness testing of algorithmic strategies. Runs Walk-Forward Optimization across rolling train/test windows, then attacks the out-of-sample equity curve with four Monte Carlo stress regimes. If your strategy survives, it's worth considering.
features: Walk-Forward Optimization with Optuna — 150 trials per 6-month window
4 adversarial Monte Carlo regimes: connectivity, sequence, temporal, GBM
Strict t+1 execution lag — eliminates lookahead bias by design
Tax engine for US / UK / India capital gains with slippage and fee modeling

name: SemanticPDF
subtitle: Production SaaS for conversational document search with auth, payments, and RAG.
description: A production web app built around the full SaaS stack: OAuth via Kinde, tiered subscriptions via Razorpay, and end-to-end type safety with tRPC from the PostgreSQL schema to the React UI. The AI part is a RAG pipeline — PDF chunks embedded via OpenAI, stored in Pinecone, retrieved on query, streamed back through GPT.
features: tRPC end-to-end type safety from database schema to React components
RAG pipeline: chunking → OpenAI embeddings → Pinecone → streaming GPT response
Razorpay subscription tiers with cryptographic webhook verification
Usage tracking, rate limiting, and self-service billing dashboard

name: Snippets
subtitle: A collaborative code workspace with real-time editing, drag-and-drop organization, and role-based permissions.
description: Organize and share code snippets on a free-form interactive canvas. Teams can edit in real-time via WebSocket connections, with per-space role-based access (Admin / Editor / Viewer). Automatic language detection drives syntax highlighting across 50+ languages.
features: Real-time WebSocket collaboration with 30s heartbeat and stale-connection cleanup
Turbo monorepo — shared Prisma types across HTTP API and WebSocket servers
dnd-kit canvas with Framer Motion animations and CodeMirror syntax highlighting
RBAC per space: owner controls, collaborator roles, and a global admin dashboard

name: StreamVault
subtitle: Self-hosted video streaming with adaptive HLS quality and FFmpeg transcoding.
description: A full-stack streaming platform where uploaded videos are transcoded server-side by FFmpeg into multi-quality HLS segments. The React frontend uses HLS.js for adaptive bitrate playback with in-player quality switching. JWT auth gates uploads and playlist management; admins can moderate any content.
features: Server-side FFmpeg transcoding to multi-quality HLS manifests on upload
HLS.js adaptive bitrate playback with live quality switching in the player
JWT auth with role-based access: users manage their own content, admins control all
Public streaming without login — auth only required to upload or create playlists
